description: This Java class handles HTTP Negotiate authentication (commonly for Kerberos) by managing account tokens via Android's AccountManager, including account selection, token retrieval, and error handling. It is used within Chromium's networking code for Android.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator
classes.description: Handles obtaining and managing authentication tokens for HTTP Negotiate (Kerberos) authentication, including account selection, token requests, and error reporting.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator.RequestData
classes.description: Holds request-specific data across asynchronous callbacks, including native result object, account info, options, and token type.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator.GetAccountsCallback
classes.description: Callback invoked after retrieving accounts; handles account selection or error reporting.

classes.name: HttpNegotiateAuthenticator.GetTokenCallback
classes.description: Callback invoked after attempting to get an auth token; handles success, errors, and user interaction.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of HttpNegotiateAuthenticator with a specified account type.

methods.name: getNextAuthToken
methods.description: Initiates the process to obtain the next authentication token for a given principal, auth token, and delegation permission.
